method: Native GodotJS headless AudioEffectRecord Master PCM plus actual AudioStreamPlayer bus/send gains; 100% volume, committed tuning.json and swaps, no saved/live human overrides. Isolated 46-case before and intermediate after. Final 10-case subset retested headroom and auditions after gain changes; final burst is 12 shots vs 4 baseline (stronger stress). First baseline near-pistol echo was dropped because test scheduled before a costly sound-set switch; fresh setup clock retest produces PCM, so this is not a game defect. Default empty mechanical/sub are tested solo. New machine-fire direct case is an API diagnostic: normal New-mode gameplay uses the five-layer rifle instead. Secondary audit adds 74 cheat/enemy cue, support-loop and enemy-gun cases in both sound sets, plus actual console auditions. World sources are at their authored unit_size (unity distance gain); cheat one-shots use the production flat actor path. First recorder/decoder warmup can miss a short drone cue; warmed retry produces PCM. New officer radio is deliberately muted by profile newMutedPaths. The final mortar/browser corrections have their own native retries. No warmup case is treated as a content defect.
